payload.reason: The dataset was collected using a combination of validated speech recordings from the Common Voice corpus and aligned sentences from the Tatoeba corpus, ensuring a diverse representation of speakers and accents.

claims.text: CoVoST was built using validated voice clips from the Common Voice corpus, which are recorded by contributors reading from a bank of donated sentences.
An evaluation set was constructed from the Tatoeba corpus, which includes aligned sentences across multiple languages and corresponding speech.
The dataset includes contributions from over 11,000 speakers and features more than 60 accents, ensuring diversity in the speech data.
